questions.stem_text:
Using conditioning, how can one determine the sensitivity of a dog's hearing to sounds of
different frequencies?

options.A: By using a controlled group of dogs not exposed to the sounds
options.B: By using sensory deprivation to heighten hearing sensitivity
options.C: By observing the dog's natural behavior in different sound environments

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - By using operant conditioning

questions.stem_text:
Why would you not expect conjugation among a group of paramecia that had descended from a
single individual through repeated fission?

options.A: Conjugation is prevented by the presence of a dominant allele
options.B: Conjugation results in lesser genetic diversity
options.C: Conjugation can occur among identical organisms
options.D: All individuals are identical genetically, and conjugation could not occur.
options.E: Conjugation does not require different mating types

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - All individuals are identical genetically, and conjugation could not occur.

questions.stem_text:
If the activity of an enzyme is constant over a broad range of pH values, it is likely
that

options.A: the enzyme is inactive at all pH values
options.B: no ionizing groups on the enzyme or substrate participate in the reaction
options.C: only ionizing groups on the substrate participate in the reaction
options.D: ionizing groups on both the enzyme and substrate participate in the reaction
options.E: only non-ionizing groups on the substrate participate in the reaction

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - no ionizing groups on the enzyme or substrate participate in the reaction

response reflects the organism's interaction with its environment.

body toward the stimulus, whereas a taxis is a type of orientation in which the animal
